description: Figure 7 is a line chart illustrating the Micro F1 score (in percent) of the KnowPrompt model as a function of the number of training samples generated by LLMs. The horizontal x-axis, labeled “Number of Samples Generated,” is discrete and shows four specific values: K=8, K=16, K=32, and K=64. The vertical y-axis, labeled “Micro F1 (%)”, ranges from 20 to 55, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 5. The chart displays four distinct lines, each representing a different method: TACRED (blue line with circle markers), TACRED-Revisit (orange line with circle markers), Re-TACRED (green line with circle markers), and SemEval (red line with circle markers). The TACRED line starts at approximately 23% for K=8, rises to about 28% at K=16, peaks at 30% for K=32, and then slightly declines to 29% at K=64. The TACRED-Revisit line begins at 22%, increases to 29% at K=16, reaches 30% at K=32, and then drops to 29% at K=64. The Re-TACRED line starts at 34%, rises to 40% at K=16, peaks at 50% for K=32, and then decreases to 48% at K=64. The SemEval line begins at 42%, increases to 45% at K=16, rises to 47% at K=32, and continues to climb to 51% at K=64. All lines show an initial increase in performance with more samples, peaking around K=32, followed by a slight decline or plateau at K=64.
